# Handoff Summary

## Status: ✅ Stable - Champion Holding

| Metric | Champion v5 | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|-------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Key Observations

1. **Champion retained** — v5 maintains edge on tuning stability and drawdown control
2. **Candidate trade-off** — `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` improved lockbox minimum but at cost of:
   - 2x worse drawdown (-11.2% vs -9.3%)
   - Unstable tuning minimum (0.05 is near-zero)
3. **No blockers** — Runloop healthy at 208 iterations, ~26h remaining

## Recommended Action

```bash
# Continue automated search (run all 3 commands in sequence)
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Priority if Manual Intervention Needed

| Priority | Focus Area | Rationale |
|----------|-----------|-----------|
| 1 | Drawdown constraint | Candidates improving lockbox but exceeding -10% MDD |
| 2 | Tuning stability | Min 0.05 suggests overfitting risk on some folds |
| 3 | Macro alpha exploration | Shadow candidate shows promise, may need regularization |

No blocking issues. System can continue autonomous operation.
